normative_extracts.spec_section: 4.5 Implied Minimum Size of Flex Items
normative_extracts.quote: To provide a more reasonable default minimum size for flex items, the used value of a main axis automatic minimum size on a flex item that is not a scroll container is a content-based minimum size.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Flex layout computes hypothetical main sizes from flex-basis, clamps against min-width: auto (min-content), and distributes remaining space.

production_failures.symptom: Long unbreakable URL or <pre> code block blows out a flex row past 100% viewport width
production_failures.root_cause: Default min-width: auto clamps flex-shrink at the item’s min-content width.
production_failures.mitigation: Set min-width: 0 (or overflow: hidden) on the flex item so text-overflow: ellipsis or wrapping can engage.

production_failures.symptom: Equal-looking flex items render at unequal widths despite flex: 1
production_failures.root_cause: flex: 1 sets flex-basis: 0%, but forgotten flex-grow: 1 with default flex-basis: auto distributes only leftover space after content width.
production_failures.mitigation: Use flex: 1 (flex-basis: 0%) for equal shares, or flex: 0 1 auto for content-proportional sizing.
